title: Tenter
summary: TENT'ER, noun [Latin tendo, tentus, to stretch.] A hook for stretching cloth on a frame. To be on the tenters, to be on the stretch; to be in distress, uneasiness or suspense. TENT'ER, verb transitive

inlines.v: TENT'ER, noun [Latin tendo, tentus, to stretch.] A hook for stretching cloth on a frame. To be on the tenters, to be on the stretch; to be in distress, uneasiness or suspense. TENT'ER, verb transitive To hang or stretch on tenters. TENT'ER, verb intransitive To admit extension. Woolen cloths will tenter
